profile.name: Vache Chek
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a highly dedicated and driven professional with a background in software development. Over the course of my career I have honed my knowledge and skills through diverse experiences across various organisations. As a self-learner I remain adaptable and astute, always seeking opportunities to further develop my expertise in software development. My enthusiastic nature allows me to thrive in challenging and rewarding environments.

Wrote comprehensive unit tests covering most functionality.
Collaborated closely with the data science team to integrate AI solutions into the product.
Continuously improved software performance and adhered to Clean Code practices.
Focused on enhancing team performance and establishing common practices.

Mentored junior developers through pair programming and demoed new tools and development features.

Spearheaded a Coding Guidelines document for the team.
Applied SOLID principles to software design and thoroughly documented all changes.

Led and mentored a team of designers and developers.

Analysed client requirements and tested software before deployment.
Focused on performance tuning and search engine optimisation.
